name: Folio
tagline: Every page has a point of view.
description: A cultured identity for a portfolio and essay platform. An offset page corner, terracotta ink, and generous serif headlines make individual work feel carefully presented.
heading: lora
rules: Page corners appear as open right angles, never closed boxes.
Use a vertical rule to separate project metadata from descriptions.
Give each featured work a full-width reading area and clear attribution.

system.concept: Folded portfolio sheets, considered page corners, warm print-stock contrast, and high-character serif display. The work and its author stay at the center.
headline: Work with
a point of view.
system.productNote: A thoughtful place for an individual voice.
features: A clear, considered presentation that lets an idea be understood.
Room for context, process, and the person who made it.
Work worth returning to, not just scrolling past.
system.layoutNote: Endpaper hero with terracotta serif type and an angled portfolio object. A thin metadata rail, large project titles, and distinctly separated author credits.
